name: rife-interpolate
description: RIFE frame interpolation by TNTwise (fork of nihui/rife-ncnn-vulkan), wrapped by FrameCore Works: smoother footage (24/30 to 60 fps), slow motion and filled-in low-frame-rate renders, run locally on the graphics card. Downloads the pinned release 20250112 only after your yes, with a SHA-256 check.

interface.longDescription: Raises the frame rate of footage, makes slow motion and fills in low-frame-rate renders with RIFE (TNTwise/rife-ncnn-vulkan, MIT) on your graphics card. The pinned release downloads once after your yes, about 830 MB, and keeps about 45 MB outside the project. Needs ffmpeg. macOS and Linux x86_64.
